reviews.title: READ THIS BEFORE GETTING THE APP.
reviews.text: I thought the ads would go away after the tutorial but they just got WORSE. And then the “Tutorial” seemed to never end. You have task after task, and it never ends. The music throws off the game, and the trees and grass? Bad. It’s says roleplay, but it’s not, it’s Task after Task and they repeat. I played this for 15-20 minutes and  between the ads and tasks I immediately gave up, closed the app, and decided to write a review, please fix any and everything of my requests. Other than those major problems I’d say the wolves are a good design, and the pack is a good size.
